3. Missingness function
```{r missingness-function}

is_missing_value <- function(x) {
  is.na(x) | 
    ifelse(is.character(x), str_squish(x) == "", FALSE)
}

missing_table <- function(data, vars) {
  map_dfr(vars, function(v) {
    x <- data[[v]]
    miss <- is_missing_value(x)
    
    tibble(
      variable = v,
      total_n = length(x),
      missing_n = sum(miss),
      missing_percent = round(100 * mean(miss), 2),
      non_missing_n = sum(!miss),
      non_missing_percent = round(100 * mean(!miss), 2)
    )
  })
}
```

4. Frequency table function

```{r frequency-function}

freq_table <- function(data, var, top_n = Inf) {
  
  total <- nrow(data)
  
  tab <- data |>
    transmute(category = as.character(.data[[var]])) |>
    mutate(
      category = str_squish(category),
      category = if_else(is.na(category) | category == "", "Missing", category)
    ) |>
    count(category, name = "n", sort = TRUE) |>
    mutate(percent = 100 * n / total)
  
  # keep only top N categories and combine the rest as "Other"
  if (is.finite(top_n)) {
    missing_row <- tab |> filter(category == "Missing")
    non_missing_rows <- tab |> filter(category != "Missing")
    
    top_rows <- non_missing_rows |> slice_head(n = top_n)
    
    other_rows <- anti_join(non_missing_rows, top_rows, by = "category") |>
      summarise(
        category = "Other",
        n = sum(n),
        percent = sum(percent),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      filter(n > 0)
    
    tab <- bind_rows(top_rows, other_rows, missing_row)
  }
  
  tab |>
    mutate(
      variable = var,
      percent = round(percent, 2)
    ) |>
    select(variable, category, n, percent)
}
```

1. Define years and file paths
```{r}
years_to_map <- c(2014, 2017, 2021, 2024)

population_data <- "/Users/abiramisomasundaram/Desktop/Brazil pesticides/Data/Dados Version 2/Dados/resultados/base_consolidada_sp_2014_2024.parquet"

sp_shapefile_path <- "/Users/abiramisomasundaram/Desktop/Brazil pesticides/Workspace/SHAPEFILES FOR MAPS-SAO PAULO BRAZIL/SP_Municipios_2025_with 6 digit/SP_Municipios_2025/SP_Municipios_2025.shp"

# Death data columns
date_col <- "DTOBITO"
age_col <- "IDADEanos"
death_muni_col <- "CODMUNRES"

# Population parquet columns

pop_muni_col <- "cod_ibge"     
pop_year_col <- "ano"         
pop_value_col <- "pop_0_14" 

# Shapefile columns
shape_muni_col <- "COD_6"      
shape_name_col <- "NM_MUN"  

# Helper function 

make_code6 <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_squish(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "\\.0$", "")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "[^0-9]", "")
  x <- if_else(x == "", NA_character_, x)
  
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    nchar(x) >= 7 ~ str_sub(x, 1, 6),
    nchar(x) == 6 ~ x,
    TRUE ~ str_pad(x, width = 6, side = "left", pad = "0")
  )
}

```


# 1. Prepare deaths dataset

```{r}
df_analysis <- df |>
  mutate(
    death_date = ymd(.data[[date_col]]),
    death_year = year(death_date),
    age_years = parse_number(as.character(.data[[age_col]])),
    code_muni_6 = make_code6(.data[[death_muni_col]])
  )


# Keep only deaths aged 0-14 in selected years 

deaths_0_14 <- df_analysis |>
  filter(
    !is.na(age_years),
    age_years >= 0,
    age_years <= 14,
    death_year %in% years_to_map,
    !is.na(code_muni_6)
  )


# Count deaths by municipality and year 

deaths_0_14_muni_year <- deaths_0_14 |>
  count(
    code_muni_6,
    year = death_year,
    name = "deaths_0_14"
  )

```

# 2. Read population denominator parquet
```{r}
pop_raw <- read_parquet("/Users/abiramisomasundaram/Desktop/Brazil pesticides/Data/Dados Version 2/Dados/resultados/base_consolidada_sp_2014_2024.parquet")

# Check available columns
names(pop_raw)

# Clean population data -----------------------------------

pop_0_14_clean <- pop_raw |>
  transmute(
    code_muni_6 = make_code6(.data[[pop_muni_col]]),
    year = as.integer(.data[[pop_year_col]]),
    pop_0_14 = as.numeric(.data[[pop_value_col]])
  ) |>
  filter(
    year %in% years_to_map,
    !is.na(code_muni_6),
    !is.na(pop_0_14),
    pop_0_14 > 0
  )

# Optional check
pop_0_14_clean |>
  count(year)

pop_0_14_clean |>
  arrange(year, code_muni_6) |>
  print(n = 20)


```

# 3. Calculate mortality rate per 100,000 children aged 0-14

```{r}

rate_0_14_muni_year <- pop_0_14_clean |>
  left_join(
    deaths_0_14_muni_year,
    by = c("code_muni_6", "year")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    deaths_0_14 = replace_na(deaths_0_14, 0),
    mortality_rate_100k = 100000 * deaths_0_14 / pop_0_14
  )


# Check highest rates
rate_0_14_muni_year |>
  arrange(year, desc(mortality_rate_100k)) |>
  select(
    code_muni_6,
    year,
    deaths_0_14,
    pop_0_14,
    mortality_rate_100k
  ) |>
  mutate(
    mortality_rate_100k = round(mortality_rate_100k, 2)
  ) |>
  print(n = 50)

```


# 4. Read São Paulo municipality shapefile

```{r}
sp_muni_sf <- st_read("/Users/abiramisomasundaram/Desktop/Brazil pesticides/Workspace/SHAPEFILES FOR MAPS-SAO PAULO BRAZIL/SP_Municipios_2025_with 6 digit/SP_Municipios_2025/SP_Municipios_2025.shp", quiet = FALSE)

# Check shapefile columns
names(sp_muni_sf)


# Clean shapefile ------------------------------------------
# The shapefile must contain municipality polygons.
# If it is only the outline of São Paulo state, it cannot show municipality-level rates.

sp_muni_sf_clean <- sp_muni_sf |>
  mutate(
    code_muni_6 = make_code6(.data[[shape_muni_col]])
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(code_muni_6)) |>
  st_make_valid()


# Optional: create municipality name column if available ----

if (shape_name_col %in% names(sp_muni_sf_clean)) {
  sp_muni_sf_clean <- sp_muni_sf_clean |>
    mutate(municipality_name = as.character(.data[[shape_name_col]]))
} else {
  sp_muni_sf_clean <- sp_muni_sf_clean |>
    mutate(municipality_name = code_muni_6)
}

# Check duplicate municipality codes in shapefile
sp_muni_sf_clean |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  count(code_muni_6) |>
  filter(n > 1)





```
# 5. Join rates to shapefile

```{r}
# Create one map row per municipality per selected year

sp_muni_year_sf <- sp_muni_sf_clean[
  rep(seq_len(nrow(sp_muni_sf_clean)), each = length(years_to_map)),
]

sp_muni_year_sf$year <- rep(
  years_to_map,
  times = nrow(sp_muni_sf_clean)
)


# Join mortality rates

map_rate_0_14 <- sp_muni_year_sf |>
  left_join(
    rate_0_14_muni_year,
    by = c("code_muni_6", "year")
  )


# For municipalities with population data but zero deaths, deaths should be zero.
# For municipalities with missing population data, rate remains NA.

map_rate_0_14 <- map_rate_0_14 |>
  mutate(
    deaths_0_14 = if_else(
      !is.na(pop_0_14) & is.na(deaths_0_14),
      0,
      deaths_0_14
    ),
    mortality_rate_100k = if_else(
      !is.na(pop_0_14) & is.na(mortality_rate_100k),
      0,
      mortality_rate_100k
    )
  )


# Join check
map_rate_0_14 |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarise(
    municipalities_years = n(),
    missing_population_rows = sum(is.na(pop_0_14)),
    missing_rate_rows = sum(is.na(mortality_rate_100k))
  )

```

# 6. Main rate map: continuous color scale

```{r}

# Project to SIRGAS 2000 / UTM zone 23S
target_crs <- 31983

map_rate_0_14_proj <- map_rate_0_14 |>
  st_transform(target_crs)


# Create São Paulo state boundary for each year
state_outline_year_proj <- map_rate_0_14_proj |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    geometry = st_union(geometry),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  st_as_sf()


# Municipality with highest mortality rate in each year
highest_mortality_labels_proj <- map_rate_0_14_proj |>
  filter(!is.na(mortality_rate_100k)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  slice_max(
    order_by = mortality_rate_100k,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      municipality_name,
      "\n",
      round(mortality_rate_100k, 1),
      " per 100k"
    )
  )
#Convert those selected municipalities to label points
highest_mortality_points_proj <- highest_mortality_labels_proj

st_geometry(highest_mortality_points_proj) <- st_point_on_surface(
  st_geometry(highest_mortality_labels_proj)
)


#plot
 ggplot() +
  # Municipality polygons with dark grey boundaries
  geom_sf(
    data = map_rate_0_14_proj,
    aes(fill = mortality_rate_100k),
    color = "grey35",
    linewidth = 0.05
  ) +
  
  # São Paulo state boundary in black
  geom_sf(
    data = state_outline_year_proj,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  
  # Labels for municipality with highest mortality rate each year
  geom_sf_label(
  data = highest_mortality_points_proj,
  aes(label = label),
  fill = "white",
  color = "black",
  size = 3,
  label.size = 0.25,
  alpha = 0.9,
  nudge_x = 60000,   # move label 60 km to the right/east
  nudge_y = 0,
  hjust = 0
)+
  
  facet_wrap(~ year) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c(
      "white",
      "#FFFFB2",
      "#FECC5C",
      "#FD8D3C",
      "#F03B20",
      "#BD0026",
      "#800026"
    ),
    na.value = "grey90",
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mortality rate among children aged 0-14 by municipality of residence",
    subtitle = "São Paulo, selected years; label shows municipality with highest rate each year",
    fill = "Deaths per\n100,000 children\naged 0-14",
    caption = "Rate = deaths among ages 0-14 / population aged 0-14 × 100,000"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )


```

#Missing ness plot :

```{r}
# Missingness for all variables in df
missing_results_all_vars <- missing_table(df, names(df))

# Keep only variables with missingness
missing_plot_all_vars <- missing_results_all_vars |>
  filter(missing_n > 0) |>
  mutate(
    variable = fct_reorder(variable, missing_percent)
  )

# Plot
ggplot(missing_plot_all_vars, aes(x = variable, y = missing_percent)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2F65A7") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(missing_percent, "%")),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_percent(scale = 1),
    limits = c(0, max(missing_plot_all_vars$missing_percent) * 1.15)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Missingness in the SIM Dataset",
    subtitle = "Only variables with at least one missing value are shown",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Missing percentage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```
